title: Mid-batch concurrent-minter griefing causes atomic rollback
description: Caller's paymentAmount budget computed against current price; concurrent direct mint by another party escalates the geometric price curve, exhausting paymentAmount mid-loop. Inner mint reverts, atomic rollback. Victim wastes gas; can retry with higher slippage.
recommendation: Document the slippage/race behavior for integrators; consider exposing a max-price-per-mint parameter so callers can set explicit slippage tolerance. Alternatively, return partial-fill semantics rather than reverting on budget exhaustion.
